opening.argument: The speaker presents MTI as a passive Bitcoin investment, saying it is “totally passive investment,” and describes a simple money flow: create an account, fund it, then wait to withdraw profits. Those are concrete instructions for placing funds into an investment, not merely general discussion of Bitcoin. The speaker further says daily profits are added to a trading pool and compounded every day, while stating that “Profits in MTI are generated through trading only.” This ties the promised profit mechanism directly to deposited funds and quantified returns. The account also mentions referral-related leadership and binary commissions. Although the description does not guarantee identical results, its combination of passive-investment claims, account funding, and compounding profits establishes the promoted investment scheme as a scam.
